description: This Java source file defines the class ContactablesLoaderCallbacks, which implements loader callback methods to manage data loading from the contacts database, including creating loaders, handling loaded data, and resetting loaders. It interacts with Android's LoaderManager and content providers to query contact information based on a search query.
external_files: R (resource file with id R.id.sample_output and R.string.intro_message)

classes.name: ContactablesLoaderCallbacks
classes.description: A helper class implementing LoaderManager.LoaderCallbacks<Cursor> for managing contact data loading via cursors. It manages creating loaders with search queries, processing loaded data to display contact info, and handling loader resets.

methods.name: ContactablesLoaderCallbacks
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the context used for accessing application resources.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates and returns a CursorLoader to query the contacts database based on the provided search query in the arguments bundle.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles the data once the loader finishes loading. It updates a TextView with contact information extracted from the cursor.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets any references to the loader's data, currently implemented as a no-op.
